terms.heroDesc: Rules and terms of service at THE XUONG SPORT — last updated: July 2025.
terms.s1b1: Welcome to THE XUONG SPORT — the e-commerce platform specializing in genuine sports gear. By accessing and using this website, you agree to comply with the terms and conditions below.
terms.s1b2: These terms apply to all activities on thexuong.xuansown.id.vn, including browsing products, placing orders, making payments and using your account.
terms.s2b1: You are responsible for providing accurate information when registering an account and for keeping your password secure.
terms.s2b1l1: Each individual is only allowed to create one account
terms.s2b1l2: You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account
terms.s2b1l3: Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized access to your account
terms.s2b2: We reserve the right to suspend or delete accounts if we detect fraud, terms violations, or behavior that harms other users.
terms.s3b1: THE XUONG SPORT is committed to providing accurate product information including descriptions, images, prices and stock status. However, actual colors may differ slightly depending on your display device.
terms.s3b2: An order is confirmed once you receive a confirmation email from the system. We reserve the right to refuse orders if we detect signs of fraud or inaccurate information.
terms.s4b1: We support multiple payment methods including credit/debit cards, bank transfer, e-wallets and cash on delivery (COD).
terms.s4b1l1: Prices shown on the website include VAT
terms.s4b1l2: Shipping fees are calculated separately and shown before payment
terms.s4b2: Delivery takes 2-7 business days depending on the region. THE XUONG SPORT is not liable for delayed deliveries caused by force majeure such as natural disasters or epidemics.
terms.s5b1: The return policy is detailed on the Returns Policy page. Summary:
terms.s5b1l1: Returns accepted within 7 days of receiving the goods
terms.s5b1l2: Products must have intact tags and be unused
terms.s5b1l3: Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days
terms.s5b1l4: Return shipping fees are paid by the customer (except for manufacturer defects)
terms.s6b1: We collect personal information (name, email, phone number, address) solely to process orders and improve user experience. Information is not shared with third parties unless required by law.
terms.s6b2: All transactions and personal data are protected with SSL encryption. We comply with industry security standards to ensure customer information safety.
terms.s7b1: All content on the website including text, images, logos, designs and source code belongs to THE XUONG SPORT or its licensed partners.
terms.s7b1l1: No copying, distributing or using content without written consent
terms.s7b1l2: Brand names and logos of partners (Nike, Adidas, Li-Ning, Puma) belong to their respective owners
terms.s7b1l3: Intellectual property violations will be handled in accordance with the law
terms.s8b1: Any disputes arising from the use of our services will be resolved through direct negotiation between both parties. If no agreement is reached, the dispute will be brought to the competent court in Vietnam.
terms.s8b2: To file a complaint, please contact us via email or the contact page with a detailed description of the issue. We are committed to responding within 48 business hours.
terms.s9b1: THE XUONG SPORT reserves the right to change or supplement these terms at any time without prior notice. The latest version will be posted on this page. Continued use of the service after changes are made constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms.ctaDesc: Contact us and we will answer any questions about our terms of service.

privacy.heroDesc: Committed to protecting your personal data — transparent, secure and compliant with the law.
privacy.overviewP1: THE XUONG SPORT is committed to protecting the privacy and personal data of its customers. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information.
privacy.overviewP2: By using our services, you agree to the terms described in this policy. We fully comply with Vietnamese law on personal data protection.
privacy.collection1Desc: Full name, email, phone number, delivery address when you register an account or place an order.
privacy.collection2Desc: Purchase history, payment methods, delivery addresses to process and track orders.
privacy.collection3Desc: IP address, browser type, device used to improve experience and secure your account.
privacy.collection4Desc: Pages viewed, visit times, website interactions to analyze and optimize our services.
privacy.purpose1Desc: Confirm, pack, deliver and handle return and refund requests.
privacy.purpose2Desc: Maintain accounts, order history, reward points and personalized offers.
privacy.purpose3Desc: Send order information, status updates and respond to support requests.
privacy.purpose4Desc: Understand user behavior to optimize interface, features and shopping experience.
privacy.purpose5Desc: Detect and prevent fraud, protect customer accounts and data.
privacy.purpose6Desc: Send promotional and new product information once you have agreed to receive updates from us.
privacy.security1Desc: All data transmitted between your browser and our servers is encrypted with 256-bit SSL/TLS.
privacy.security2Desc: Payment information is processed through PCI DSS compliant payment gateways and never stored on our systems.
privacy.security3Desc: Only authorized employees can access customer data, with full logging.
privacy.security4Desc: Data is backed up regularly with a recovery plan in place for incidents.
privacy.right1Desc: View the personal information we store about you.
privacy.right2Desc: Request updates or corrections to inaccurate or outdated information.
privacy.right3Desc: Request deletion of personal data, unless the law requires us to keep it.
privacy.right4Desc: Refuse processing of your data for direct marketing purposes.
privacy.right5Desc: Revoke previously given consent at any time.
privacy.right6Desc: Submit a complaint to the competent authority if you believe your rights were violated.
privacy.cookiesP1: We use cookies to improve your experience on the website. Cookies are small files stored on your browser.
privacy.cookiesNecessary: Keep the website working properly (login, cart, security).
privacy.cookiesAnalytics: Help us understand how you use the website to improve our services.
privacy.cookiesP4: You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but some features may not work properly.
privacy.ctaDesc: Our team is ready to answer any questions about our privacy policy and your rights.

shippingPolicy.heroDesc: Nationwide delivery — fast, safe and transparent, from our warehouse to your door.
shippingPolicy.overviewP1: THE XUONG SPORT partners with reputable carriers to ensure your order reaches you as quickly and safely as possible.
shippingPolicy.overviewP2: We deliver nationwide with a range of speed options. Free shipping on orders of {amount} or more.
shippingPolicy.overviewP3: Every order is carefully packed and comes with a tracking code so you can easily check its journey.
shippingPolicy.option1Desc: The popular option with a reasonable cost. Suitable for non-urgent orders, delivered within the estimated time.
shippingPolicy.option2Desc: Priority processing and faster shipping. Ideal when you need the goods soon, especially within the city.
shippingPolicy.option3Desc: Delivered the same day for HCMC and Hanoi inner-city areas. Receive your goods just hours after ordering.
shippingPolicy.option4Desc: Cash on delivery. Inspect the products before paying the delivery staff.
shippingPolicy.feature1Desc: Every product is shock-proof packed to arrive intact from our warehouse to your hands.
shippingPolicy.feature2Desc: Get your tracking code as soon as the order is handed to our carrier partner.
shippingPolicy.feature3Desc: Track the location and status of your order directly on the website or app.
shippingPolicy.feature4Desc: Delivery staff will call to confirm before arriving at the delivery address.
shippingPolicy.feature5Desc: If you are not home, the order will be redelivered up to 3 times at no extra cost.
shippingPolicy.feature6Desc: With COD, you can inspect the products before paying the shipper.
shippingPolicy.note1Desc: Orders placed before 3 PM are processed and handed to the carrier the same day. Orders after 3 PM are processed the next day.
shippingPolicy.note2Desc: You can change the address before the order is handed to the carrier. After that, please contact support.
shippingPolicy.note3Desc: If the order has not arrived 7 days after the estimated time, contact us immediately for handling and compensation.
shippingPolicy.note4Desc: Some special products may incur an additional packing fee. This is clearly shown at checkout.
shippingPolicy.trackingP1: Once your order is handed to the carrier, you will receive an email and notification with the {code} to track its journey.
shippingPolicy.trackingP2: Log in to your account and open the {orders} section to see real-time delivery status, parcel location and estimated arrival time.
shippingPolicy.trackingP3: If your order status is not updated within 48 hours, please contact support for a check.
shippingPolicy.ctaDesc: Our customer care team is ready to help you track and resolve any delivery issues.

returnsPolicy.heroDesc: Transparent, fast returns — customer benefits always come first.
returnsPolicy.overviewP1: THE XUONG SPORT supports returns within {days} of receiving your order for products with intact tags that have not been used.
returnsPolicy.overviewP2: Returned products must include the full packaging, accessories and purchase receipt. Return shipping fees are paid by the customer unless the defect is from the manufacturer.
returnsPolicy.overviewP3: Refunds are processed within {days} after the returned product is inspected and confirmed.
returnsPolicy.step1Desc: Submit a return request via the contact page or email with your order code and return reason.
returnsPolicy.step2Desc: Pack the product with intact tags, packaging and accessories. Include the purchase receipt.
returnsPolicy.step3Desc: Send the package to the provided address. Keep the shipping receipt for tracking.
returnsPolicy.step4Desc: The product is inspected within 2-3 business days. The result will be notified via email.
returnsPolicy.step5Desc: Refund to the original payment method or send a replacement product as requested.
returnsPolicy.condition1Desc: The product must include full packaging, tags and accessories.
returnsPolicy.condition2Desc: The product must not be used, washed or show signs of wear.
returnsPolicy.condition3Desc: The return request must be submitted within 7 days of receiving the goods.
returnsPolicy.condition4Desc: Provide the purchase receipt or order code to verify the transaction.
returnsPolicy.condition5Desc: The returned product must match the product purchased on the order.
returnsPolicy.condition6Desc: The product must pass quality inspection before the return is accepted.
returnsPolicy.exclusion1Desc: Products showing signs of wear, washing or use are not eligible for returns.
returnsPolicy.exclusion2Desc: Return requests after 7 days from receiving the goods will not be processed.
returnsPolicy.exclusion3Desc: Some products in special promotions may not be eligible for returns.
returnsPolicy.exclusion4Desc: Products missing tags, original packaging or accessories are not accepted.
returnsPolicy.ctaDesc: Our customer care team is ready to support you 24/7.

paymentMethodsPage.heroDesc: A wide range of payment methods — safe, fast and convenient for every order.
paymentMethodsPage.overviewP1: THE XUONG SPORT supports many popular payment methods, helping you complete your order quickly and securely.
paymentMethodsPage.overviewP2: All transactions are SSL/TLS encrypted and processed through reputable PCI DSS compliant payment gateways.
paymentMethodsPage.overviewP3: For any payment questions, please contact our support team for the fastest answers.
paymentMethodsPage.method1Desc: Pay in cash directly to the delivery staff when you receive the product. Inspect the goods before paying for total peace of mind.
paymentMethodsPage.method2Desc: Pay fast via MoMo, ZaloPay, ShopeePay. Scan the QR code or confirm in the app — the transaction completes within seconds.
paymentMethodsPage.method3Desc: Pay with ATM cards from Vietnamese banks via the Napas payment gateway. Supports over 40 domestic banks.
paymentMethodsPage.method4Desc: We accept Visa, Mastercard and JCB. Transactions are SSL encrypted and 3D-Secure authenticated to protect your card details.
paymentMethodsPage.method5Desc: Transfer directly via Internet Banking or at the branch. The system automatically confirms once the payment is received.
paymentMethodsPage.feature1Desc: Transactions are confirmed within seconds and orders are processed right after successful payment.
paymentMethodsPage.feature2Desc: SSL/TLS encryption, PCI DSS compliant payment gateways, no card details stored.
paymentMethodsPage.feature3Desc: From cash to e-wallets and bank cards — something for every need.
paymentMethodsPage.feature4Desc: Scan QR codes, confirm with fingerprint, one-tap payment on your phone.
paymentMethodsPage.feature5Desc: With COD, you can inspect the product before paying the shipper.
paymentMethodsPage.feature6Desc: Our support team is ready to answer any payment questions at any time.
paymentMethodsPage.security1Desc: All payment data is transmitted over encrypted connections, preventing information theft.
paymentMethodsPage.security2Desc: We work with gateways that meet international security standards to ensure transaction safety.
paymentMethodsPage.security3Desc: An extra security layer for international cards, requiring confirmation from the issuing bank.
paymentMethodsPage.security4Desc: Card information is only processed by the payment gateway and never stored on our systems.
paymentMethodsPage.faq1A: Check your balance or card limit, or try another method. Contact support if the issue persists.
paymentMethodsPage.faq2A: No extra fee. You only pay the exact order value when receiving the products.
paymentMethodsPage.faq3A: We currently support MoMo, ZaloPay and ShopeePay. Other wallets will be added in the future.
paymentMethodsPage.faq4A: Yes. Transactions are protected by 3D-Secure and card information is never stored on our systems.
paymentMethodsPage.faq5Q: How long does a bank transfer confirmation take?
paymentMethodsPage.faq5A: Usually 5-15 minutes. If no confirmation after 1 hour, please contact support.
paymentMethodsPage.faq6A: Not yet. The feature will be launched in the near future.
paymentMethodsPage.ctaDesc: Explore our collection of genuine sports gear and pay easily with your favorite method.

sizeGuide.heroDesc: Detailed instructions on how to measure your body and standard size charts for clothing and footwear.
sizeGuide.step1Desc: Use a soft measuring tape to measure your body. Make sure the tape is not too tight or too loose.
sizeGuide.measure1Desc: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape level with the ground. Do not pull it tight.
sizeGuide.measure2Desc: Measure around the narrowest part of the waist, usually about 2-3cm above the navel.
sizeGuide.measure3Desc: Measure around the widest part of the hips and buttocks, keeping the tape parallel to the ground.
sizeGuide.measure4Desc: Stand straight without shoes and measure from the top of your head to your heels.
sizeGuide.measure5Desc: Measure from the crotch down to the heel to choose the right pants size.
sizeGuide.chartNote: * Measurements may vary by 1-2cm depending on the brand
sizeGuide.tip1Desc: Your body tends to be smaller in the morning after waking up.
sizeGuide.tip2Desc: Measure over a thin layer of clothing for the most accurate numbers.
sizeGuide.tip3Desc: Make sure the tape stays parallel to the ground when measuring.
sizeGuide.tip4Desc: If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the larger size for comfort.
sizeGuide.tip5Desc: Left and right feet can differ — use the measurements of the larger foot.
sizeGuide.tip6Desc: Contact us for accurate sizing advice for each brand.
sizeGuide.ctaTitle: Still not sure about your size?
sizeGuide.ctaDesc: Our support team is ready to help you find the best-fitting size.

about.heroDesc: E-commerce platform for genuine sports gear — alongside athletes and sports lovers across Vietnam.
about.storyP1: THE XUONG SPORT was founded with the goal of making genuine sports gear easy and trustworthy to own for every athlete and sports lover in Vietnam.
about.storyP2: We believe the right equipment not only improves performance but also fuels passion. Every product on our platform is carefully selected from the world's leading brands.
about.storyP3: Our vision is to become the most trusted destination for genuine sports gear, where customer trust always comes first.
about.commitment1Copy: Every product has a clear origin from NIKE, ADIDAS, LI-NING, PUMA. Found counterfeit, 10x compensation.
about.commitment2Copy: Football, badminton, running, basketball… full range of equipment and apparel for every need.
about.commitment3Copy: Fast support, flexible returns, nationwide delivery — always by your side.
about.commitment4Copy: Competitive prices, guaranteed quality, transparent and clear warranty policies.
about.value1Copy: Trust is the foundation of everything we do — we keep our promises to customers.
about.value2Copy: We love sports and pour that energy into every product.
about.value3Copy: Every decision starts from customer benefit and experience.
about.value4Copy: Constantly updating products and services to exceed expectations.
about.value5Copy: Transparent in sourcing, pricing and warranty policies.
about.value6Copy: Contributing to a growing sports community in Vietnam.
about.testimonial1Quote: First time buying running shoes at TheXuong and received genuine gear, neatly packed. Will definitely come back.
about.testimonial2Quote: Needed badminton gear urgently, the shop advised warmly and delivered on time. Service as committed.
about.testimonial3Quote: A trustworthy sports marketplace. Every product has a clear origin and competitive pricing.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to level up your sports experience?
